```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as std from "@pulumi/std";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const example = new tencentcloud.monitor.NoticeContentTmpl("example", {
    tmplName: "tf-example",
    monitorType: "MT_QCE",
    tmplLanguage: "en",
    tmplContents: {
        qcloudYehes: [{
            matchingStatuses: [
                "Trigger",
                "Recovery",
            ],
            template: {
                email: {
                    titleTmpl: std.base64encode({
                        input: "AlarmTitle{{.AlarmName}}",
                    }).then(invoke => invoke.result),
                    contentTmpl: std.base64encode({
                        input: "AlarmContent{{.AlarmContent}}",
                    }).then(invoke => invoke.result),
                },
                sms: {
                    contentTmpl: std.base64encode({
                        input: "Alarm: {{.AlarmName}}",
                    }).then(invoke => invoke.result),
                },
            },
        }],
        weWorkRobots: [{
            matchingStatuses: ["Trigger"],
            template: {
                contentTmpl: std.base64encode({
                    input: "AlarmContent: {{.AlarmName}}",
                }).then(invoke => invoke.result),
            },
        }],
        dingDingRobots: [{
            matchingStatuses: ["Trigger"],
            template: {
                titleTmpl: std.base64encode({
                    input: "AlarmTitle: {{.AlarmName}}",
                }).then(invoke => invoke.result),
                contentTmpl: std.base64encode({
                    input: "AlarmContent: {{.AlarmContent}}",
                }).then(invoke => invoke.result),
            },
        }],
        feiShuRobots: [{
            matchingStatuses: ["Trigger"],
            template: {
                titleTmpl: std.base64encode({
                    input: "AlarmTitle: {{.AlarmName}}",
                }).then(invoke => invoke.result),
                contentTmpl: std.base64encode({
                    input: "AlarmContent: {{.AlarmContent}}",
                }).then(invoke => invoke.result),
            },
        }],
    },
});
```

## Import



Monitor notice content template can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Monitor/noticeContentTmpl:NoticeContentTmpl example ntpl-3r1spzjn
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
